versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for discovering e-commerce and DTC brands on Instagram and TikTok.
- Automates finding and filtering brands by scraping product-category hashtags and detecting commercial signals in account bios.
- Supports both Instagram and TikTok via Apify actors or REST API fallback.
- Output includes brand handle, follower count, bio excerpt, product category, engagement rate, and more.
- Customizable filters: product category, platform, follower range, number of brands, and brand-bio signals.
- Ideal for wholesale suppliers, B2B outreach, and SaaS targeting e-commerce brands.
